rule_breakdown.description: Work is marked completed or 100% progressed but lacks completion date certificate.
Dates do not follow logical progression (recommendation <= sanction <= work order <= completion).
Financial amount fields (estimate, sanction, payments, expenditure) must be >= 0.
The specified district does not exist under the declared state.
GPS coordinates are missing or lie outside Indian territorial boundaries.
The mandatory primary key (work_id) is missing or blank.
Physical progress percentage is outside the valid range of 0.0% to 100.0%.
Total released payments exceed the administrative sanctioned limit for this work.
